_: Why the tracker was not read: one row per reason, the Tracker line the standup and triage print for it in the terminal and on the page. key is the consts.json rituals.text template, values fill its placeholders, line is the sentence. halves says which half can fail for that reason (an Azure DevOps Space and a missing gh in both; the agent alone probes the tier and catches a reader that raised; the CLI alone reads one repository and refuses several, and its triage alone says a local Space is not asked). A row with gh is a gh list read of repo that fails that way -- raises (the error's own name or message), exits with stderr, or answers stdout that is not JSON -- and each suite drives its own reader with it: Invoke-P20RitualGh in Tests/Test-Rituals.ps1, the tracker reader in Tests/test_rituals.py. A row with target is Resolve-P20TrackerRepo's or tracker_repos' refusal for that Space. Every tracker* key of rituals.text, and adoTracker, has a row.
